subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper own crawl-remote production deployment with Vincent Koc as the sole workflow dispatcher under the proposed protected-environment and Cloudflare-token controls?
rationale: The code enforces a defensible boundary, but transferring production authority, selecting the durable operator policy, and accepting the live environment and credential configuration require repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve this authority model
options.body: Accept ClawSweeper as the deployment control plane, independently verify the environment-only least-privilege token and approval rules, and supervise the first dormant rollout.

options.title: Revise operator policy
options.body: Keep the technical isolation but define a different durable dispatcher or environment approval policy before merge.

options.title: Keep deployment elsewhere
options.body: Do not merge this workflow if production authority should remain in crawl-remote or a dedicated operations repository.

recommendation.title: Approve this authority model
recommendation.body: Accept ClawSweeper as the deployment control plane, independently verify the environment-only least-privilege token and approval rules, and supervise the first dormant rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged ownership trail for ClawSweeper workflow, dispatch, repair, and state-publication architecture and is best positioned to approve the cross-repository production boundary.
